authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10158 mukha gives Prakrit muha “mouth, face” and northern/eastern mu/muh/mui, with Khowar mux. The survey contracted mu/moh/mui forms fit the mouth/face family; unaspirated muk needs separate review of the retained stop. The comparative family link retains uncertainty about transfer between Indo-Aryan languages. RNS uncertainty is locality attribution only, as established by the source audit; source tags are retained.

Survey retroflex stop spelling is preserved as an audit qualification; the hand/arm family remains well identified. The comparative family link retains uncertainty about transfer between Indo-Aryan languages.
